patch_description: Extends the strongest low-parameter ansatz with a shared global RX conversion layer tied to the existing central CRZ parameter. The two CRZ bridges retain the current model’s high validation accuracy, while the noncommuting RX layer improves phase-to-population conversion and is expected to accelerate convergence, as observed in the faster prior architecture. Parameter sharing keeps the model at four circuit parameters per block and 26 total parameters, preserving regularization and parameter efficiency.
